critical_code_review_comments: PortalStatePayload treats safety_ack/safety_plan as fully replaceable (default=None) — a client that PUTs the state doc without these fields silently clobbers server-side values to None. The frontend correctly always includes them in the debounced PUT, but any partial-update client (e.g. a future mobile app or a migration script) would need to be aware. Consider a PATCH endpoint or `exclude_unset` semantics if partial writes become desirable.

_sanitize_safety_plan trusts the client-provided updated_at (only capped at 40 chars, not validated as ISO-8601). A malicious client could push arbitrary strings there; low impact since the field is caller-scoped and only rendered client-side, but consider parsing to datetime and re-serialising for consistency.

SafetyPlanBuilder.onSave writes the plan only when at least one field has text (early-return in persist()). There is no explicit 'clear plan' affordance — a parent who wants to wipe their saved plan has to sign out or manually clear localStorage, and the server copy will persist. Consider a 'Delete my Safety Plan' control.

SacoparentsPortal.jsx remains over the 700-line guideline (called out in iter71). The iter72 delta added safetyPlan state + hydration + a debounced PUT branch — still worth extracting a usePortalSync hook.
